title: Warm Spicy American Chicken Casserole
description: A malty, crisp, and nostalgic American dish featuring ancho chillies, this casserole is perfect for a weeknight dinner. It is a nut-free-friendly option for those with dietary restrictions.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion and garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
In a large bowl, whisk together the malt syrup and 1/4 cup of water.
Add the ancho chillies to the bowl and whisk until well combined.
Add the cooked chicken and onion mixture to the bowl and stir until coated with the malt syrup mixture.
In a greased 9x13 inch baking dish, arrange half of the crushed tortilla chips in the bottom of the dish.
Add the chicken mixture on top of the tortilla chips.
Sprinkle the shredded cheddar cheese over the top of the chicken mixture.
Arrange the remaining tortilla chips on top of the cheese.
